snippets: Your booking is visible in our system. The booking includes the breakfast you selected, and the booking shows two guests. To amend the booking, open the booking from your confirmation email. We can also update the booking by phone if you prefer to speak with someone before your arrival.

The cache holds recent responses so the cache can return them quickly. Each entry in the cache has an expiry time stored beside it in the cache. When that time passes, the cache removes the entry. A later request gives the cache an opportunity to fetch a fresh response from the upstream server.

This release adds a panel for saved searches. The panel sits beside the results, with a panel header showing the current folder. Inside the panel, you can rename a search or drag it into another folder. Closing the panel preserves your selection, so reopening the panel brings you back to the same place.

We need a plan for the office move. Our plan should cover packing, and the plan needs to include the equipment cupboard. Please put your suggestions for the plan in the shared document. Once the plan is ready, I will send the plan to facilities so they can arrange access to the loading bay.

The monthly service includes a report after each visit. That report arrives by email, and you can also find the report in your account. The annual service supplies a report in the same way. Whichever option you choose, the report describes the work completed and the report gives you a record to keep for your landlord.

The hall will reopen on Monday. Visitors to the hall can use the side entrance while the hall roof is being repaired. We have moved the hall noticeboard beside that entrance, where you can check the hall timetable. Please contact the caretaker if you need help finding your group inside the hall.

I liked the bag as soon as I unpacked it. The bag has a wide opening, and the bag feels comfortable on my shoulder. After a week, the bag still looks new. I take the bag on the train every morning, and I would recommend the bag to anyone carrying a laptop and a few books.

Students learn the distinction through examples. As students learn, they begin to notice differences they missed before learning the rule. They learn more through discussion and learn again when they explain an answer to a partner. By learning in this way, students develop the confidence to attempt unfamiliar questions without waiting for the teacher.

A useful review starts with listening. During a review, people need space to explain their choices. The review then becomes a chance to understand what happened, rather than a formality. I now leave more time for each review because a rushed review rarely gives the team enough room to discuss what the next review should cover.

Jon waited beside the gate until the gate rattled in the wind. He put his hand against the gate and felt the cold metal. Beyond the gate, the path disappeared into weeds. He had remembered the gate as taller, but now the gate barely reached his shoulder, and he could see the empty house beyond it.
